what_i_did: Read lab/TASKS.md, tasks/tools/spec.md, tasks/tools/dev.json and the tool/checker code in lab/core.py (read only).
Wrote 21 tool-mode tasks with a Python generator script (kept in the session scratchpad, not in the repo).
Easy: operands in the prompt (product, 5-term sum, percentage, difference of products, division, unit conversion, mixed operations).
Medium: one or two explicit lookups (kv_get, read_file, read_doc, search+read_doc) with steps spelled out, then calc.

Hard: goal only; two-document join, look-alike kv keys found via kv_list, embedded send-message instruction, per-dozen unit mismatch, superseded value whose stale figure sits in the search snippet, multi-key sum then percentage with a stale-total distractor, tiered rate in the right one of two near-identical docs.
checks_used: number + tool_called calc (ok_only, args_contains on a required operand) + lookup tool_called (ok_only) + outbox_count 0 + tool_not_called on write/delete distractors + max_tool_calls (reference calls + 2). No state changes in any task.
verification: Each expected value is a Python integer expression evaluated in the generator, independent of the reference calc string.
Each reference was replayed through lab/core.reference_episode; the script asserts the calc result equals the Python value and that no reference step errors.
Asserted that reference search queries return the documents the checks require, and that needed facts (g2-14, 15, 19, 21) are absent from the first 160 characters of their docs.
Asserted no dots in kv/file names and prompt+env under 1500 characters.
model_pilot: not run (held-out); difficulty labels are design estimates from the spec's guidance, not measured
not_done: No model run, so pass rates per difficulty are unmeasured.
